in_sanskrit.name: Thokchom
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Mountain
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Thokchom एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Thokchom is a Hindu name derived from the Manipuri language. It translates to 'Lord of the Mountain'. This name is inspired by the mythological figure of the same name, who is believed to be the protector of the mountains and a symbol of power, strength, and wisdom.
